pe_construction: Parameter-tree read-back on policyengine-uk 2.147.2, no simulation: gov.dwp.universal_credit.rebalancing.new_claimant_share read at 1 June of each tax year.

new_claimant_share.description: Share of benefit units with the Universal Credit LCWRA element that are new claimants, paid the new-claimant amount rather than the protected (pre-2026) amount. The rebalancing scenario uses it to assign the status by a seeded draw when the data do not supply it; a household situation without the status gets the protected amount. The shares for 2026-27 to 2029-30 are WPI Economics' estimates for the Trussell Trust from administrative Personal Independence Payment data (2025). Later years hold the 2029-30 share. That is an assumption, not a source: the share keeps rising as the caseload turns over, so holding it understates new claimants and overstates protected amounts from 2030-31.
references: Universal Credit Act 2025 s. 2 (new-claimant and protected LCWRA amounts)
